{{Quote|Hang on&hellip; you're after those data files I lifted? I knew I should have charged more for that heist!|translated=1|Vistis Garn, upon learning why the Knight was pursuing him|<ref name="Stolen Secrets" />}}
Near the end of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], a [[Hero of Tython|Jedi Knight]] and the [[T7-series astromech droid|astromech droid]] [[T7-O1]] '''raided''' a [[Migrant Merchants' Guild warehouse|warehouse]] belonging to the [[Migrant Merchants' Guild]], a criminal syndicate that controlled the [[Old Galactic Market]] region on the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], in order to recover stolen weaponry and the design files for the [[Planet Prison]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]]. The duo confronted the team of [[Scoundrel/Legends|thieves]] who had [[Raid on a Republic Military warehouse|stolen]] the weapons and files from the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]], and the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] defeated the criminals and their leader, the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Vistis Garn]]. However, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and T7-O1 learned from Garn that the files had already been sent to the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal syndicate, and the pair were called back to the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] in order to deal with [[Kidnapping of Doctor Tarnis|another crisis]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Thirty-two hours ago, thieves raided a military storehouse. They stole weapons, supplies and data files for the Planet Prison project.|Agent Galen|<ref name="Stolen Secrets" />}}
In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] sensed a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark]] [[Disturbance in the Force/Legends|disturbance in the Force]] on the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and sent the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Bela Kiwiiks]] with her [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Kira Carsen]], to investigate.<ref name="Enemy Force">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Enemy Force|Tython}}</ref> However, the dark presence was actually the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Tarnis (Sith Lord)|Tarnis]], who was posing as a Republic [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] named Eli Tarnis within the [[Republic superweapon initiative]], a weapons development program. Feeling that further investigation by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] would reveal his identity, Tarnis contacted the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal syndicate and traded Imperial weapons and [[Armor/Legends|armor]] in exchange for its services. On Tarnis's orders,<ref name="The Rescue">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|The Rescue|Coruscant}}</ref> Black Sun sent the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Scoundrel/Legends|thief]] [[Vistis Garn]], who occasionally worked with the [[Migrant Merchants' Guild]], one of Black Sun's rivals, to [[Raid on a Republic Military warehouse|steal]] the design files for Tarnis's project, the [[Planet Prison]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]]. Raiding a [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] [[Unidentified Republic Military warehouse|warehouse]] with a team of Guild criminals, Garn acquired files on the entire superweapon initiative and also made off with a shipment of advanced weapons and munitions.<ref name="Stolen Secrets" />

However, Garn was caught on a [[Security camera/Legends|security camera]] as he was leaving, allowing the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] and the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]]&mdash;the Republic's intelligence agency&mdash;to identify the Rodian almost thirty [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] later.<ref name="Stolen Secrets" /> By then, Kiwiiks had requested reinforcements from the Council, and Jedi Master [[Orgus Din]] and his [[Hero of Tython|former apprentice]] arrived from Tython around the same [[Time/Legends|time]]. Along with the [[T7-series astromech droid|astromech droid]] [[T7-O1]], Din's now-[[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knighted]] former student met with the other Jedi, Doctor Tarnis, and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Var Suthra]] of the Republic Military in the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Tower]]. [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Galen (SIS)|Galen]], the head of the SIS branch stationed in the Senate Tower, interrupted the Jedi's meeting to report that his analysts had found a lead, and Suthra left the young Knight and Carsen with Galen while he and the Jedi Masters departed to meet with [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Dorian Janarus]].<ref name="The Jedi Envoy">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|The Jedi Envoy|Coruscant}}</ref> Galen's agents had tracked Garn back to a [[Migrant Merchants' Guild warehouse|warehouse]] in the Guild-controlled [[Old Galactic Market]] region, and the SIS agent dispatched the Jedi Knight and Teeseven to retrieve the stolen weapons and files. While Galen and Carsen remained at the Senate Tower and used the [[Coruscant security network|CSF's security network]] to distract the criminals, the Knight and Teeseven took an [[Air taxi/Legends|air taxi]] to the Old Galactic Market.<ref name="The Jedi Envoy" />

==The raid==
{{Quote|A Jedi&mdash;that's all I need! Nothing personal, but I have to kill you!|translated=1|Vistis Garn|<ref name="Stolen Secrets" />}}
Upon reaching the warehouse, the Knight and Teeseven surprised six Guild members&mdash;an [[Abyssin/Legends|Abyssin]], three [[Ongree/Legends|Ongree]], and two Rodians&mdash;while they were unloading their stolen goods, and the pair defeated the criminals and their rewired [[Security droid/Legends|security droid]] in the resultant battle. Before breaking through the security door behind which Garn had barricaded himself, the pair recovered the stolen munitions, weapons, and rockets from among the other illicit goods in the warehouse. Finding the door sealed, the Knight cut through it with a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and entered the room, and an alarmed Garn apologized before activating a quartet of [[Autoturret/Legends|autoturrets]]. Deflecting and dodging the [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolts, the Knight and Teeseven disabled the turrets and defeated Garn, and the injured thief quickly surrendered and offered information to the Jedi.<ref name="Stolen Secrets" />

==Aftermath==
{{GameLS}}
{{Quote|Let's make a deal, huh? I have the data files, but the guild already decrypted them. I transmitted a copy to my clients. You want the people who hired me. I'll tell you where they are&mdash;if you promise to let me go.|translated=1|Vistis Garn|<ref name="Stolen Secrets" />}}
[[File:Vistis_hurt.png|thumb|right|150px|Vistis Garn]]
The Knight contacted Galen via [[Holocomm/Legends|holocomm]] and reported the pair's success, but an agitated Galen ordered the Jedi to bring the design files back as quickly as possible&mdash;they had had a major breach of security while the Knight was in the Market. Galen refused to say anything more on an unsecured channel and ended the transmission. Realizing what the Jedi was after, Garn offered to tell the Knight who had hired the Guild to steal the files and where to find them if the Jedi would let the Rodian go. When the Jedi agreed, Garn revealed that he had been hired by Black Sun and that he had helped the Guild steal the files so that he could send an unencrypted copy to Black Sun once the Guild's [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] had decrypted them. Honoring their deal, the Knight allowed Garn to leave, and the Rodian told the pair that he was going to visit friends on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="Stolen Secrets" /> The Knight and Teeseven then returned to the Senate Tower, where they learned that Black Sun had [[Kidnapping of Doctor Tarnis|kidnapped Tarnis]].<ref name="Kidnapped" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The raid on the Migrant Merchants' Guild warehouse appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]], as the [[in-universe]] events of the Jedi Knight-class mission "Stolen Secrets" on Coruscant. After recovering the stolen files and defeating Garn, the player can choose to either [[Death/Legends|kill]] the thief for dark-side points after learning about Black Sun, or let him leave in peace for varying amounts of [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light-side]] points. Warning the thief about the consequences of lying before sparing him results in fifty light-side points, while simply letting him leave results in 100.<ref name="Stolen Secrets" />
